Source: Claude Design handoff, extracted to `handoff/`. The zip, the
prototype runtime (`support.js`) and the designer's import prompt were
removed; only the spec, the two HTML references and the screenshots remain.
**Lifecycle:** `handoff/` is deleted once every screen matches its
screenshot; this file stays as the durable record of the tokens.
`handoff/README.md` is the designer's spec and the **source of truth** for
values; this file is Claude's inventory of it, translated toward Flutter. When
the two disagree, the handoff wins and this file gets fixed.

## What is in the handoff

| File | Use |
|---|---|
| `handoff/README.md` | Full spec: tokens (light + dark), type scale, Tile (7 states), Sensei (4 states), 18 screens, interactions, state needs. Read first. |
| `handoff/Tenpai - Système de design.dc.html` | Design-system page. Exact tile shadows/gradients live in its `Component` class (bottom of file). |
| `handoff/Tenpai - Écrans.dc.html` | 18 screens × light/dark. Sections marked `data-screen-label="…"`. Do not run; grep it for values. |
| `handoff/screenshots/NN-*.png` | 36 captures, 390×844, `-dark` suffix for dark mode. Pixel reference. |

## Scope the handoff adds to the original brief

- **Dark mode** (warm black-brown, never pure black). Tile face stays ivory in dark; only its drop shadow deepens.
- **Onboarding** (3 screens) and **auth** screen with email/password + Google and Apple OAuth (Apple irrelevant while Android-only).
- **Sensei** = the AI feature's UI: hanko seal `先`, tinted panel with a 3 px green left rule; states loading (three pulsing tiles, never a spinner), streaming (block caret), error (grey seal, never blocking), offline (dimmed "Pourquoi ?" link + note).
- **Six units** named: Lire les tuiles · Les briques d'une main · La table · Le déroulé d'une partie · Gagner · Le score.
- **Profile** with streak, XP, tiles mastered, 7-day activity, badges.
- **French microcopy**, verbatim from the handoff. No emoji.
- Fonts: **Outfit** 400–700, **IBM Plex Mono** 400–500. Bundle TTFs under `assets/fonts/` (no `google_fonts` package).

## Shape, spacing, motion

| Token | Value |
|---|---|
| radius card/button | 16 |
| radius tile | 10 (16 on the 110 px demo tile) |
| radius sub-panel | 12 |
| radius seal | 6 |
| radius bottom sheet top corners | 24 |
| radius progress bar | 3 (height 6) |
| radius device frame | 40 (prototype only) |
| side margin | 20 |
| spacing scale | multiples of 8 |
| shadow surface | `0 2px 12px rgba(28,26,23,.06)` |
| shadow primary button | `0 4px 14px rgba(30,107,82,.25)` |
| shadow tile | `0 4px 10px rgba(28,26,23,.12)` + bevel: `inset 0 2px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.95)`, `inset 0 -4px 0 rgba(28,26,23,.09)` |
| transition | 250 ms, cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.3, 1) |
| button pressed | translateY(1px), darker fill |
| sensei loading | 3 tiles 11×15, translateY(−5) + opacity .4→1, 1.2 s, delays 0/.2/.4 s |
| sensei caret | 8×15 green block, blink `steps(1)` 0.9 s |

Flutter notes: `inset` shadows do not exist in `BoxDecoration`; the bevel is
two thin overlay layers (top highlight, bottom shade) inside a `Stack`, or a
`CustomPainter`. Multiple `BoxShadow`s cover the outer shadow + ring. The
cubic-bezier maps to a `Cubic(0.2, 0.8, 0.3, 1)` curve.

## Tile component (the one renderer)

Base ratio 64×88 (≈ 8:11). Sizes used: 24×34 (hand row), 48×66 (options),
64×88 (default), 110×152 (lesson demo). Symbol is a hatched placeholder until
SVGs arrive.

| State | Fill | Ring / halo | Extra |
|---|---|---|---|
| normal | face gradient | — | — |
| selected | face gradient | `0 0 0 3px bamboo` | lift −6 px, stronger shadow |
| correct | success gradient | ring bamboo | ✓ badge, bamboo circle, top-right, overhanging |
| incorrect | error gradient | ring vermillion | ✕ badge, vermillion circle |
| highlighted | face gradient | halo `0 0 0 6px rgba(30,107,82,.15)` | — |
| faceDown | back gradient | inner frame `rgba(255,255,255,.18)` 2 px | no symbol |
| red five | face gradient | — | symbol in vermillion + 8 px red dot top-right |

## Port order (each: you write, test-writer adds tests, reviewer checks)

1. Colour tokens (light + dark) → your theme file(s)
2. Spacing / radius / shadow / motion tokens
3. Fonts bundled + declared in `pubspec.yaml`, text theme
4. `ThemeData` light + dark from an explicit `ColorScheme` (not `fromSeed`)
5. Tile widget, 7 states, placeholder symbol, 4 sizes
6. Primary / error / secondary buttons, segmented control, chip
7. Progress bar, bottom sheet (24 px top corners), feedback panel
8. Sensei panel: seal, rule, 4 states, pulsing-tiles loader, caret
9. Path node (completed / current with ring + "3/6" / locked), tab bar
10. Yaku card, hand row, option card

A debug gallery route showing every component and every tile state side by side
makes screenshot comparison against `handoff/screenshots/` cheap.
